001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.path.CSVPath;
005import java.io.BufferedReader;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.InputStreamReader;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
011import java.io.Writer;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.Arrays;
015import java.util.List;
016import java.util.stream.Collectors;
017
018/**
019 * CSV Filter Command Class
020 *
021 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from CSV using column selectors. Unlike
022 * CsvNavigateCommand which applies transformations, CsvFilterCommand only extracts/filters columns
023 * based on specified column names or indices without any modifications.
024 *
025 * <p>Features: - Extract specific columns using column names or indices - Preserve exact data
026 * values from extracted columns - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for multiple
027 * column selection
028 */
029public class CsvFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
030
031  private final List<CSVPath> columnSelectors;
032  private final boolean hasHeader;
033
034  // Deprecated fields for backward compatibility
035  @Deprecated private final List<String> legacyColumnSelectors;
036
037  /**
038   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single column selector.
039   *
040   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to extract (e.g., "name", "2")
041   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
042   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector is null or empty
043   * @deprecated Use {@link #CsvFilterCommand(CSVPath, boolean)} instead
044   */
045  @Deprecated
046  public CsvFilterCommand(String columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
047    if (columnSelector == null || columnSelector.trim().isEmpty()) {
048      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null or empty");
049    }
050    this.legacyColumnSelectors = Arrays.asList(columnSelector.trim());
051    this.columnSelectors = Arrays.asList(new CSVPath(columnSelector.trim()));
052    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single typed column selector.
057   *
058   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to extract
059   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
060   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector is null
061   */
062  public CsvFilterCommand(CSVPath columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
063    if (columnSelector == null) {
064      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null");
065    }
066    this.columnSelectors = Arrays.asList(columnSelector);
067    this.legacyColumnSelectors = Arrays.asList(columnSelector.getPath());
068    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Constructor for CSV filtering with multiple column selectors.
073   *
074   * @param columnSelectors list of column names or indices to extract
075   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
076   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelectors is null or empty
077   * @deprecated Use {@link #CsvFilterCommand(List, boolean)} with CSVPath list instead
078   */
079  @Deprecated
080  public CsvFilterCommand(List<String> columnSelectors, boolean hasHeader) {
081    if (columnSelectors == null || columnSelectors.isEmpty()) {
082      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selectors cannot be null or empty");
083    }
084    this.legacyColumnSelectors = new ArrayList<>(columnSelectors);
085    this.columnSelectors = columnSelectors.stream().map(CSVPath::new).collect(Collectors.toList());
086    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Private constructor for internal use with typed column selectors.
091   *
092   * @param columnSelectors list of typed CSVPaths to extract
093   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
094   * @param internal marker parameter to distinguish from deprecated constructor
095   */
096  private CsvFilterCommand(List<CSVPath> columnSelectors, boolean hasHeader, boolean internal) {
097    if (columnSelectors == null || columnSelectors.isEmpty()) {
098      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selectors cannot be null or empty");
099    }
100    this.columnSelectors = new ArrayList<>(columnSelectors);
101    this.legacyColumnSelectors =
102        columnSelectors.stream().map(CSVPath::getPath).collect(Collectors.toList());
103    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Factory method for CSV filtering with multiple typed column selectors.
108   *
109   * @param columnSelectors list of typed CSVPaths to extract
110   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
111   * @return a CsvFilterCommand instance
112   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelectors is null or empty
113   */
114  public static CsvFilterCommand create(List<CSVPath> columnSelectors, boolean hasHeader) {
115    return new CsvFilterCommand(columnSelectors, hasHeader, true);
116  }
117
118  /**
119   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single column selector (assumes header exists).
120   *
121   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to extract
122   * @deprecated Use {@link #create(CSVPath)} instead
123   */
124  @Deprecated
125  public CsvFilterCommand(String columnSelector) {
126    this(columnSelector, true);
127  }
128
129  /**
130   * Factory method for CSV filtering with single typed column selector (assumes header exists).
131   *
132   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to extract
133   * @return a CsvFilterCommand instance
134   */
135  public static CsvFilterCommand create(CSVPath columnSelector) {
136    return create(columnSelector, true);
137  }
138
139  /**
140   * Factory method for CSV filtering with single typed column selector.
141   *
142   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to extract
143   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
144   * @return a CsvFilterCommand instance
145   */
146  public static CsvFilterCommand create(CSVPath columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
147    return create(Arrays.asList(columnSelector), hasHeader);
148  }
149
150  /**
151   * Constructor for CSV filtering with multiple column selectors (assumes header exists).
152   *
153   * @param columnSelectors list of column names or indices to extract
154   * @deprecated Use constructor with List&lt;CSVPath&gt; instead
155   */
156  @Deprecated
157  public CsvFilterCommand(List<String> columnSelectors) {
158    this(columnSelectors, true);
159  }
160
161  @Override
162  protected String getCommandDetails() {
163    List<String> selectorPaths =
164        columnSelectors.stream().map(CSVPath::getPath).collect(Collectors.toList());
165    return String.format("CsvFilterCommand(columns=%s, hasHeader=%s)", selectorPaths, hasHeader);
166  }
167
168  @Override
169  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
170      throws IOException {
171    try (BufferedReader reader =
172            new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
173        Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
174
175      List<Integer> columnIndices = new ArrayList<>();
176      String[] headers = null;
177
178      // Read first line
179      String firstLine = reader.readLine();
180      if (firstLine == null) {
181        // Empty CSV
182        writer.flush();
183        return;
184      }
185
186      String[] firstRowFields = parseCsvLine(firstLine);
187
188      if (hasHeader) {
189        headers = firstRowFields;
190        // Map column selectors to indices
191        columnIndices = mapColumnSelectorsToIndices(columnSelectors, headers);
192
193        // Write filtered header
194        writeFilteredRow(writer, firstRowFields, columnIndices);
195        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
196      } else {
197        // No header - column selectors must be numeric indices
198        columnIndices = parseNumericColumnSelectors(columnSelectors, firstRowFields.length);
199
200        // Write filtered first data row
201        writeFilteredRow(writer, firstRowFields, columnIndices);
202        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
203      }
204
205      // Process remaining data rows
206      String line;
207      while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
208        String[] fields = parseCsvLine(line);
209        writeFilteredRow(writer, fields, columnIndices);
210        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
211      }
212
213      writer.flush();
214    }
215  }
216
217  /**
218   * Map column selectors to column indices
219   *
220   * @param selectors list of column names or indices
221   * @param headers array of header names
222   * @return list of column indices
223   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if column not found
224   */
225  private List<Integer> mapColumnSelectorsToIndices(List<CSVPath> selectors, String[] headers) {
226    List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
227
228    for (CSVPath selector : selectors) {
229      int index = selector.resolveIndex(headers);
230      if (index == -1) {
231        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column not found: " + selector.getPath());
232      }
233      indices.add(index);
234    }
235
236    return indices;
237  }
238
239  /**
240   * Parse numeric column selectors when no header exists
241   *
242   * @param selectors list of column indices as strings
243   * @param totalColumns total number of columns available
244   * @return list of column indices
245   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if index is invalid
246   */
247  private List<Integer> parseNumericColumnSelectors(List<CSVPath> selectors, int totalColumns) {
248    List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
249
250    for (CSVPath selector : selectors) {
251      if (!selector.isIndexBased()) {
252        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
253            "Column selector must be numeric when no header: " + selector.getPath());
254      }
255
256      int index = selector.getColumnIndex();
257      if (index < 0 || index >= totalColumns) {
258        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column index out of range: " + selector.getPath());
259      }
260      indices.add(index);
261    }
262
263    return indices;
264  }
265
266  /**
267   * Parse a CSV line into fields (simple implementation)
268   *
269   * @param line CSV line
270   * @return array of field values
271   */
272  private String[] parseCsvLine(String line) {
273    // Simple CSV parsing - handles basic comma separation
274    // For production, consider using a proper CSV library
275    if (line == null || line.isEmpty()) {
276      return new String[0];
277    }
278
279    List<String> fields = new ArrayList<>();
280    StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();
281    boolean inQuotes = false;
282
283    for (int i = 0; i < line.length(); i++) {
284      char c = line.charAt(i);
285
286      if (c == '"') {
287        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
288      } else if (c == ',' && !inQuotes) {
289        fields.add(current.toString().trim());
290        current.setLength(0);
291      } else {
292        current.append(c);
293      }
294    }
295
296    fields.add(current.toString().trim());
297    return fields.toArray(new String[0]);
298  }
299
300  /**
301   * Write filtered row with only selected columns
302   *
303   * @param writer output writer
304   * @param fields all field values
305   * @param columnIndices indices of columns to include
306   * @throws IOException if writing fails
307   */
308  private void writeFilteredRow(Writer writer, String[] fields, List<Integer> columnIndices)
309      throws IOException {
310    for (int i = 0; i < columnIndices.size(); i++) {
311      if (i > 0) {
312        writer.write(",");
313      }
314
315      int columnIndex = columnIndices.get(i);
316      if (columnIndex < fields.length) {
317        String field = fields[columnIndex];
318        // Quote field if it contains comma or quotes
319        if (field.contains(",") || field.contains("\"")) {
320          writer.write("\"" + field.replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"");
321        } else {
322          writer.write(field);
323        }
324      } else {
325        // Column doesn't exist in this row - write empty field
326        writer.write("");
327      }
328    }
329  }
330}
